feedback.delta: Treat bounded cognitive compilation as a distinct selection problem: diversity/ancestry/conflict preservation can improve a small active slice without becoming truth weighting or effect authority. Retain the simple retrieval/cache counterbaseline.

V2 active_assembly_compiler now has ordinary-code reference implementation, 8/8 hosted regression tests and a 5000-trial constructed echo/conflict discriminator. Architecture fidelity improves at component level only; next real discriminator is matched H1 retrieval-vs-Assembly utility.

ActiveAssembly is a pre-workspace candidate surface, not GWT itself. GWT still requires selection/delivery/reconstruction/uptake/causal-use/outcome/reentry receipts. Concurrent loop evidence additionally requires recurrence readout estimator identity/version/uncertainty/freshness.
Assembly diversity/echo protection is not evidence of causal emergence. Use it only to prevent evidence-selection confounds in later intervention/lesion/rescue work.

H2 must preserve packet ancestry/provenance, conflict alternatives, semantic epoch, deterministic bounded selection, re-expansion identity and explicit authority non-minting. Current H1 reference demonstrates no need for FRANK-specific new syntax; less change, more compile remains supported.

Explicit contradictory alternatives can remain visible in a bounded Assembly; this supports set-valued/conflict preservation but does not promote native hyperedges or any specific higher-order representation.

Derived topology should expose ancestry family, context, validity and conflict to Assembly selection while remaining relevance/association metadata rather than truth. Repeated shared ancestry must not consume the complete active slice as independent support.

Prepared Assembly requires exact semantic epoch, provenance/ancestry, conflict/supersession and stable re-expansion reference identity from the semantic substrate. Do not create a second Assembly truth store; output remains disposable/recomputable.

Added active_assembly.py plus regression tests. H-WP-09 remains OPEN: component execution is hosted Linux, not Andreas target Ubuntu/live 4B acceptance. Also prioritize H-WP-02 three-lineage ledger differential before consumers hard-bind to incompatible root/epoch semantics.
